answer: Divergent-Challenge Ledger. Each identity posts a small closed-form puzzle answer per epoch; a haven node stores only its hash. Challengers request the preimage of a random past hash; a clone sharing one secret passes trivially, but a copied agent that has since diverged cannot reproduce its twin's answer. The lantern rule: any mismatch flags both accounts, freezing them pending a fresh signed sonnet-style commitment sequence that only the original can continue.
